title: The Call of Disciples
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Mark 1:16-20: Jesus sees Simon and Andrew casting a net, says "Follow me, and I will make you fishers of people", they leave their nets at once; James and John leave their father in the boat; people are called today to serve in many roles.

floor.question: Name the two brothers called first.

representations: a lake with two boats drawn
cards of people who serve today
steps: They leave their nets at once.
He calls James and John too.
contexts: a nurse who serves with love
a young person in the church choir

board.do: Draw a lake and a boat with two men casting a net.

board.say: What did Jesus say to these men?

board.do: Wait for the child to say "Follow me, I will make you fishers of people".
List ways people serve God today.

misconceptions.ask: What were Simon and Andrew doing when Jesus called them (Mark 1:16)?
misconceptions.repair: Make two cards: Simon and Andrew, fishermen; Matthew, tax collector.

misconceptions.ask: What did Jesus say to Simon and Andrew?
misconceptions.repair: Read Mark 1:17: "fishers of people". Ask why fishermen would understand this.

misconceptions.ask: Who is called to serve God today?
misconceptions.repair: List people who serve God in work: a nurse, a teacher, a farmer, a choir member.

misconceptions.ask: What did Simon and Andrew do when Jesus called them (Mark 1:18)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Mark 1:18 and 1:20 and underline "at once" and "without delay".

checks.question: What were Simon and Andrew doing when Jesus called them?
checks.answer: Casting a net into the lake

checks.question: Who is called to serve God today?
checks.answer: People in many kinds of work and roles
